end.summary:
Practised what common animals eat: plant-eaters, meat-eaters, and animals that eat both.
Named grass and leaves as plant foods, and identified a plant as a food source.
Built and read food chains: grass → insect and algae → larvae → fish.
Explained that food moves from a leaf to a caterpillar; teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised animal food choices and simple food chains with Manav. They correctly built and read three arrow-based chains and explained how food moves from a leaf to an insect. They were unsure about what happens when food is unavailable and about leaves on the ground; this was not corrected later in the lesson. At home, ask Manav to draw one food chain and explain each arrow aloud.
